title: Dhadha: The Mind's Wanderings Cease, When One
summary: Patience is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society
lifeApplication: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society
source.lifeApplication: Patience becomes more truthful when the mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society.

evidence.coreClaim: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society
evidence.turn: Patience becomes luminous when it begins listening for Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
